title: Recheck v2 input
description: The one validated input structure (pilot-contract.md section 2). Direct invocation builds it from the user's request and the workspace; a calling station passes it whole. Checks the schema cannot express (unique items, run_dir outside the workspace, build_doc containment after symlinks, conflicting grants) belong to the semantic validator named in section 9. Binding hash (section 11 step 3, lane contract ruling E8-9): a checkpoint's input_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of the presented input with invocation removed, authorization.extra_continuation removed, and authorization removed when those removals leave it with no keys; the continuation grant is read from the presented input at each resume, after the binding check, on the user channel. Revision 5 (2026-09-13, docs/plans/2026-09-13-recheck-v2-e8-core.md): invocation.harness and invocation.model are objects (E8-18), invocation.session_wrote_fix (E8-13), invocation.run_date (E8-25), and invocation.turn_attribution (E8-24) are new.

run_id.description: fresh and single-use for a new run; reused only with resume: true

run_dir.description: absolute scratch path outside the workspace

resume.description: continue the run whose checkpoint sits in run_dir

name.description: the harness, e.g. claude-code, codex-cli, opencode

entry.description: how the skill was loaded: plugin, host skill, explicit path

sandbox.description: the permission or sandbox mode in force

harness.description: the adapter's report of the harness in force (section 13); optional in the schema, supplied at run time; a missing object is filled with name unknown and reported (E8-18)

id.description: the model id the session reports

floor_class.description: the capability class the adapter asserted from the id, per the E9 profile

floor_met.description: whether that class satisfies policy.model_floor: true, false, or null for unknown

settings.description: the adapter configuration actually in force: sampling, thinking, tool schema version, and the like

model.description: the adapter's report of the model in force (sections 13 and 14); optional in the schema, required before anything is graded: a missing object or floor_met null is verifier_unavailable (unknown_capability), floor_met false is verifier_unavailable (below_floor) (E8-18)

session_wrote_fix.description: whether the driving session authored any fix under review (section 7); stored in the checkpoint, a resume uses the stored value; an upgrade under true is recorded as disputed (E8-13)

run_date.description: the calendar date every record this run writes carries; absent means the machine's local date; stored in the checkpoint (E8-25)

turn_attribution.description: the adapter's map from turn_ref to who produced that turn (section 8); a grant whose turn_ref maps to anything but user is rejected; absent means the field rules of section 8 alone apply (E8-24)

workspace.description: absolute path to the repo root under test; must be a git work tree

source_identity.description: the revision the caller expects; any subset of fields; a mismatch stops the run as stale_source

build_doc.description: the build doc, relative to the workspace

slice.description: slice letter or name; omitted means resolve per contract section 3

named_items.description: the user's naming door; each must resolve to exactly one record entry

review_sheet.description: path to the inspection sheet; null means none; omitted means auto-discover <workspace>/REVIEW.md

model_floor.description: a capability class the E9 harness profile maps model ids to; never a model id

severity_table.description: the default mapping; a governing review sheet's bar overrides it

claim.description: one line, no carriage return, line feed, or middle dot anywhere: it is a ledger field

document.description: the doc the entry lives in, or the caller's 'chat verdict' record

heading.description: the block heading, e.g. '### 2026-09-19 — review: Slice A', or 'chat verdict'

failure_scenario.description: the test, one line; a scenario reconstructed from a claim needs the user's confirmation first

slice.description: the slice the entry belongs to, or 'none' when the record has no card

channel.description: the adapter's user channel; the only channel the core accepts

turn_ref.description: the harness's reference to the user's message, as the E9 profile defines

quoted_words.description: the user's words that granted it, verbatim, one line; an inner double quote is written as a single quote on the ledger

forwarded_by.description: the calling station that forwarded the grant unchanged

quoted_words.description: the user's words that granted it, verbatim, one line; an inner double quote is written as a single quote on the ledger

commit.description: normalized to the full hash before comparison

submodules.description: the pilot supports no initialized submodule
